meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: Claude 在 claude-mem observer 任务里只回两种内容：`<skip_summary />` 或一条完整 `<observation>` XML，不写散文。产出写进 outbox/{id}.txt，或直接作为 chat-completions 返回体。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上接到 claude-mem observer 任务时接管。空闲、初始化、没有工具结果时返回 skip_summary，出现可检索的完整单元时输出一条 observation。

say.text: 这是一条 claude-mem observer 任务，按规则回复
把这次结果整理成一条 observation，事实带文件路径
say.note: 会生成带标题和 4–10 条事实的 XML

say.text: 这次没有可记内容，返回 skip_summary
say.note: 输出跳过标记，不写散文

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude handling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot replies only with <skip_summary/> or one full <observation> XML, never prose. Output goes to outbox/{id}.txt or the chat-completions body.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give it a claude-mem observer job on Grok Bot. On idle, init, or no tool results it returns <skip_summary/>; for a finished searchable unit it returns one <observation>.

say_en.text: This is a claude-mem observer job; reply by the rules
say_en.note: Only skip_summary or one observation XML

say_en.text: Turn this result into one observation with file paths
say_en.note: Produces XML with a title and 4-10 facts

say_en.text: Nothing worth recording here, return skip_summary
say_en.note: Emits the skip marker, no prose
